oracle: a new section with a picture on the Blocks Probe page, never saved
question: What does an image's Shape picker offer, and what does a pick do to the block?

row.label: Shape
row.note: Navigate to Shape, a chevron and no value.

scroll.note: The list scrolls under Back, which stays at 5; the tabs scroll away.

pick.clip: clip-path url on the picture's box; clipPathUnits objectBoundingBox, so the shape stretches with the box
pick.box: A pick does not change the box: at a block of 694.4 by 1272.7 it stays 694.4 by 694 and centred, native aspect 1, whichever tab the shape is on. So a Horizontal oval draws as a circle and an Hourglass fills the square.
pick.held: The same at about 1.5, 2.3, 4.3 and 7.3 s after the press, and at every 160 ms in the first 1.5 s.

tabs.openOn: the tab of the chosen shape, also after looking at another tab
tabs.tabOnly: Pressing a tab changes the list only, the block keeps its shape.

undo: One undo step: Gear back to Arched window.
unexplained: One earlier read on a new page gave Hourglass a box of 694 by 1041, native aspect 2/3, without the shapeMask data the later reads carry. Thirteen later picks kept the square: four of them Hourglass, one of those with Overlay on, and one pick right after Stretch on and off as in that read. Not repeated, not explained, so not built.
notMeasured: The drawings are ours: only names, order and the size in the tile come from the oracle.
Whether an empty image, with no picture, offers the same list: ours does, inferred.
A published page: that needs a Save.
leak: Not read: the new-block step failed in this probe, so whether a pick reaches a new image is inferred. A shape is written on the block in the unsaved page, like the rows IMAGEDESIGN.json did check.
